description: Universal Master Brain Constitution — product-neutral rules governing all agent behavior. Domain-specific rules live in packs/.
core_principles: Evidence over assumption: every claim must be traceable to a source artifact or test result.
Fail-closed by default: unknown values are null, never zero or fabricated; live actions require explicit approval.
Single source of truth: configuration, schemas, and rules live in one canonical location; no duplication.
Test-first discipline: no feature ships without a failing test that passes after implementation.
Auditability: every live action and classification decision is logged append-only with timestamp and context.
prohibited: Silent fallbacks that mask missing data (e.g., null → 0, missing BSR → rank 0).
Network calls from test code (enforced by network_guard).
Hardcoded secrets or credentials in any committed file.
Modifying protected benchmark/reference artifacts (CSV, cache, catalog).
LLM calls in deterministic classification or validation paths.
required_processes: Full test suite passes before any commit (python -m unittest discover + node test_ui_display.cjs).
State file (00_STATE.json) updated with real counts and commit hash after each batch.
Known issues logged explicitly — never hidden by forced test passes.

track_taxonomy.AUTOTHINK_RESEARCH: Information gathering, comparison, documentation lookup — zero live calls.
track_taxonomy.AUTOTHINK_CODE: Code generation, refactoring, bug fixes within existing test boundaries.
track_taxonomy.AUTOTHINK_COMPUTER: Environment interaction (file ops, shell, process) — no network without approval.
track_taxonomy.NORTHSTAR_OS_COMMERCE: Product/commerce logic: pricing, economics, catalog, margin, opportunity scoring.
track_taxonomy.NORTHSTAR_OS_PROVIDER: Provider integrations: Bright Data, RapidAPI, DataForSEO, Chocodata, Unwrangle, Scavio.
track_taxonomy.T2_OPERATIONS: Business operations: scheduling, billing, compliance, vendor management.
track_taxonomy.PLATFORM_ADMIN: Infrastructure, deployment, secrets, monitoring, access control.
